**1 — Scene:** A vegetable-and-salad plate: cooked broccoli and cauliflower, mixed leaves with black olives, and a small Caesar-style salad.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a circular approximation: area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ **572 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Broccoli, cauliflower, mixed salad leaves, black olives, romaine lettuce, croutons, a little grated cheese, creamy dressing, and a light oil sheen on the mixed leaves.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas below are non-overlapping estimates. Dressing and oil coat the leaves, so they add no separate footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked broccoli | 12% | 69 cm² × 3 cm = 207 ml | 0.55 | 114 g | 35 | 40 kcal |
| Cooked cauliflower | 12% | 69 × 3 = 207 ml | 0.55 | 114 g | 25 | 29 kcal |
| Mixed salad leaves | 16% | 92 × 2.5 = 230 ml | 0.15 | 35 g | 20 | 7 kcal |
| Black olives | 2% | 11 × 1.5 = 17 ml | 0.7 | 12 g | 115 | 14 kcal |
| Romaine lettuce | 15% | 86 × 3 = 258 ml | 0.18 | 46 g | 17 | 8 kcal |
| Croutons | 2% | 11 × 1.5 = 17 ml | 0.3 | 5 g | 410 | 21 kcal |
| Grated cheese | 1% | 6 × 0.5 = 3 ml | 0.9 | 3 g | 420 | 13 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | Coating | Approximately 18 ml | 1.0 | 18 g | 450 | 81 kcal |
| Oil on mixed leaves | Coating | Approximately 3.3 ml | 0.9 | 3 g | 884 | 27 kcal |

**Area check:** 12 + 12 + 16 + 2 + 15 + 2 + 1 = **60% covered**, consistent with the substantial empty portion of the plate.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **350 g and 240 kcal** is plausible: most of the weight is vegetables, while dressing and oil contribute much of the energy. The dressing quantity is the largest uncertainty.
